summary: Sub-feature D — Super Admin Express Management Overview: End-to-end backend + frontend testing on the new PostgreSQL baseline. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_express_overview.py covering /api/admin/modules/express/stats KPI shape+values, live KPI updates after a fresh parcel booking (active_bookings incremented +1, drivers_available dropped from 30/30 -> 28/30 confirming the simulator reserved drivers), /api/admin/modules/express/bookings list shape+all fields, status filter matrix (searching/active-family/delivered/any), unknown status -> 400, country filter (CI/LR/invalid returns empty), fuzzy search by ref/partial-ref/receiver name/phone, and 401 for unauth. Frontend: logged in as super admin, verified all 6 KPI tiles render with correct data-testids (kpi-active_bookings, kpi-completed_today, kpi-searching_now, kpi-cancelled_today, kpi-drivers_available, kpi-avg_trip_min), Recent bookings card + View all → link navigates to /admin/modules/express/bookings, filter chips render (with one minor testid naming note below), country selector + search + refresh present, bookings rows have data-testid='bookings-row-<id>' with 'View' link data-testid='bookings-open-<id>', regression MART overview still shows its 6 KPIs and does NOT show module-tab-bookings.
action_items: MINOR/NAMING (not blocking): The 'All' filter chip on /admin/modules/express/bookings uses data-testid='bookings-filter-any' (the internal EXPRESS_STATUS_FILTERS code is 'any'), while the review request literally listed 'bookings-filter-all'. All other chips (active/searching/driver_assigned/arriving/picked_up/in_transit/delivered/cancelled) match exactly. If E1 wants strict spec match, either rename the code to 'all' in EXPRESS_STATUS_FILTERS + adjust the API bypass (currently `if status && status != 'any'`), OR add a duplicate data-testid alias. Not a bug, just a naming choice — the chip is fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: ModulePages.jsx is now ~1192 lines — approaching the >700 line threshold. Consider splitting ModuleOverview, ModuleBookings, StatusPill and shared config into separate files for maintainability.

Live-refresh setInterval in ModuleBookings uses [filter, country, q] as deps but only calls `load()` inside — every keystroke in the search input restarts the 15s timer. Consider using a ref or debouncing.
In routes.py list_express_bookings, `q` search uses ILIKE with a raw %pattern% — fine for now but on larger tables consider a trigram index on ref/receiver_phone/receiver_name.
drivers_available is returned as a string '28/30' — this makes it inconsistent with the other numeric KPIs; frontend has to special-case it. Acceptable per spec but noted.
